title: This Meeting is the Greatest Blessing

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Top Road-san.
Among the lights of our generation,
of what manner is yours?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When she asked me,
I couldn't put an answer into words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't think of an answer...
because I'm not as unique as everyone else.
I may have thought that,
at least a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Digital-chan,
this script was amazing! But...
my role's pretty important,
isn't it? Are you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean?
The Santa King is the glue that holds the
group together.
Just like you are for the others.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When Opera O-san read it,
she said "The presence of the Santa King
has magnified the rulers' brilliance
myraidfold!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Eheheh.
Then it looks like I'll have to work even
harder!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
Digital-chan.
How's the rest of the production going?
You look really tired to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Uhh.... well...
I've got a good idea for the costumes,
but for the rest...
"The grind waits for no one",
you know what I mean? Haha. Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The grind...? So, basically,
you're in a pinch?
You shouldn't try to handle this all by
yourself! Let's split up the work!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"The more I admire you,
the darker my dorknesh..."
Ugh... I goofed up again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Doto-chan.
Looks like you're having trouble with your
lines, huh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I am... I just can't get it right...
Ughhhhnn... What should I dooooo?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How about you practice with me――
No, with everyone?
I think it'd help a lot.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
――Oh, Top Road-san. Making the rounds?
Would you like to rehearse our lines
together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Opera O-chan,
you're so good at acting...!
You're on a completely different level from
the rest of us...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am more versed in the art,
after all. However,
there is no need for you to match my skill.
All you need to do is immerse yourselves in
your roles!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
......Opera O-chan. Please,
teach us how to do that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san! Let's rehearse together!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You don't need to make those puppy dog eyes.
I'll practice with you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...There's still a lot that needs to be done.
I'm sorry...
I'm planning to spend a whole day to grind
it all out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we set up a day for everyone
to work?
Oh, I know!
Let's make it a weekend work day!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Well, here we are!
It's time for our weekend work day!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Hang on,
when did it get to this point...?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
HAHAHAHA!
It's as if the scene transitioned seamlessly
from her suggestion to the real thing!
So this is what Top Road-san can make happen
when she puts her everything into it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For a play,
we all need to be in it together! 
If we rehearse and work on the play as a group,
we can really get things done!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And so, Opera O-chan,
we're ready to be your acting students!
It's best to leave the teaching to the expert,
after all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Now, then...
Let's begin by gauging your skills,
shall we?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see, I see.
――Digital-kun, are the costumes ready yet?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, the Sun King costume isn't done yet,
but the rest of them are ready to go!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Let's return.
Once we do,
all of you will change into your costumes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Your dress is the same as the one from the
park, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It is...
It's impressive how good a copy it is.
Oh... The brooch on our waists...
They match.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, about that,
the backstory there is the Ice King gave it
to the Santa King as a thank-you gift!
The Ice King is the one who wanted them to
match, you know~ Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is that it?
Ayabe-san wanted to match with me...
Wait, no! It's was the character,
not her! Hehehe, sorry for the mix-up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Okay... we're all changed now.
So what's next?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You'll be spending a day as your roles!
You must think kingly thoughts,
and act as a king would!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh!? ...Um, can you explain why?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is not enough for your performance to be
artful.
The true value of this production is that
it was built by all our hands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It may seem you are merely playing roles,
but I want to put your hearts into this play.
Consider this practice for becoming one with
your roles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okay... I understand. Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhhh...
I- I don't know if I can do iiit...

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
............
...What on earth are we doing...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come now,
there's nothing to be learned from
silence! And Ayabe-san,
do you truly think the Ice King would say
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...O-okay, then,
Ice King and King of Darkness! And,
Sun King too! Time to start our meeting.
Let's fill our glasses and have a good
time.

Hang on.
How is this fair?
Your role speaks the way you normally do.
text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A-ya-be-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter,
Ice King? Are you hurting at all?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......Indeed. My head is aching.
So I may occasionally speak in an
uncharacteristic manner.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Pff...! W-well,
there's not much we can do about that...
You know,
you're not nearly as cold as I thought you'd
be!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Pizza's here,
everyone! Let's break for lunch!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
..................
Uuhhh... Through the gap...
Just put the pizza in...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-you don't need to keep that on,
Doto-chan!
There's no way you can eat like that!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, Santa King. Are you quite well?
I do not recall you using that manner of
speech.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What's wrong wi...
Why would it be improper,
given the situation!? In addition,
should we not be donning aprons?
We would not want our clothes to be
sullied!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahahahaha! You're doing marvelously,
my dear kings!
